10 Essential AI Job Search Tips

1. Bridge the AI Skill Gap

Start with these fundamentals then level up:

  • Core Skills: Python, TensorFlow, data preprocessing
  • Emerging Skills: NLP, neural network architectures

Showcase 3-5 projects demonstrating:

  • Real-world problem solving
  • Clear business impact metrics
  • Collaboration evidence via Git history

3. ATS-Optimize Your Resume

Think of ATS as poker - you need the right hand to get to the human round:

  1. Mirror exact phrasing from job descriptions
  2. Use Jobscan|https://www.jobscan.com for keyword matching
  3. Quantify achievements with AI metrics (e.g. "Improved model accuracy by 38%")
